entries.partTitle: Secure Gateway (SG) Veneers & NSC Entry Points

spec.title: Secure Gateway (SG) Veneers & NSC Entry Points — Register Bit Architecture

steps.caption: Step 1: Initialize IOT_SEC_CR1 with EN bit asserted (0x80) [D14P1].
Step 2: Peripheral asserts RDY & IRQ flags (0xE0) on IOT_SEC_CR1.
Step 3: Enable DMA burst & CRC verification bits (0xF8).
Step 4: Full TX/RX frame committed with ERR=0 verified (0xFE).
